ven if you’re young About 800,000 people suffer a stroke each year in the United States. While nearly three-quarters of strokes occur in people over 65 and the risk about doubles each decade after age 55, the stroke rate is rising in young adults under 49. Why stroke causes severe disruption Stroke occurs when blood flow to the brain is interrupted. When this happens, brain cells begin to die because they stop getting oxygen and nutrients. Damage to cells and brain connections following a stroke can cause severe problems with movement, balance, sensation, swallowing, thinking, memory, and understanding language — not to mention emotional problems.
